as_told.title: Mountain bike incident turns Blitch from skeptic

plain: In 1995 a mountain bike ride at Daniels Park, a burial ground south-southwest of Denver, Colorado, left a man with "at least 5 hours" he could not account for, the kind of gap people who report alien abductions call "missing time." The man is John Blitch, a scientist with DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, and he tells Michels it happened to him, mentioning Cindy Blitch as part of the story. Elsewhere in the same conversation he tells it without the place or the length of time, and describes it as the moment he stopped being a skeptic: "I was on the skeptical side until the mountain bike incident."
